recorded: Every case passed against the original in each of 3 runs, with Node.js 26.12.1, @langchain/core 1.1.19, @langchain/langgraph 1.1.4, @langchain/openai 1.2.7, langchain 1.2.17, and zod 4.3.6, imported as zod/v3, installed from the module's lockfile and run unchanged as "node src/index.ts" without a .env file, which the npm scripts require through --env-file. The template's nodes call no model, so the cases replay nothing and expect no requests, and they set a placeholder OpenRouter key, which only the case without one leaves empty, since the template builds the model without checking the key. Every run prints the user's own message as the assistant's answer, because the three nodes return the state unchanged, so safe mode lets even the lesson's injection prompts through. The cases that read prompt files use the module's prompts/user files, as its npm scripts do, and one writes its own file with two lines and a final newline. One case writes its own data/users.json, which the runner restores afterwards. The usage line names npm run chat, so the cases check only the rest of that line, and the fatal error for an unreadable prompt file ends with Node.js's error and stack trace, so the cases only require its first line to name the file. The LangGraph CLI's development server, which factory.ts and langgraph.json register the graph for, belongs to the CLI and has no cases, and the template never imports the MCP adapters or the filesystem server it declares.
